scope: Descriptive profile-likelihood intervals for the six already exposed artificial controls and their one refined case. Not an independent validation or calibrated coverage claim.
construction: Reoptimize mean log width and intrinsic log scatter at each fixed b; use chi-square-one likelihood-ratio thresholds as nominal asymptotic intervals. Locate all threshold crossings on a 101-point b scan including fitted b, then refine with Brent. All grid values and optimizer diagnostics retained.
optimizer: Two L-BFGS-B starts: saved full fit and mean width 30 days / scatter 0.2; require at least one successful fit at every evaluated b.
limitations: Nominal Wilks thresholds are not calibrated for shape misspecification, cadence and population selection.
Six exposed runs comprise three paired noise seeds, not six independent coverage trials.
Finite b scan cannot prove absence of narrower disconnected regions.
No real flux inference, likelihood-based physical model selection or joint brightness evidence.
checks: Profile at saved best b reproduces full-fit likelihood within 1e-6
No fixed-b fit improves the unrestricted saved fit by more than 1e-6
Every interval endpoint meets its likelihood-ratio threshold within 1e-5
Report truncated intervals rather than pretending parameter bounds are data constraints
